name: app.engramo/mcp
title: EngrAmo
description: Create and study EngrAmo spaced-repetition flashcards from your AI client.

environmentVariables.name: ENGRAMO_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your EngrAmo API token. From study.engramo.app: person icon (top right) → API token → Generate.

environmentVariables.name: ENGRAMO_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the EngrAmo API.

environmentVariables.name: ENGRAMO_TTS_GEMINI_API_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own free Gemini API key(s) from aistudio.google.com, comma-separated, to enable card audio generation. Leave unset to turn audio off.
